Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed building and site data, portables, and specialized spaces (e.g., STEAM labs, athletic fields). Robust condition assessments with prioritization of immediate and long-term needs, including HVAC, roofing, plumbing, and technology infrastructure (Sections 5, 6, and site summaries).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment data by grade and ethnicity with long-term projections and capacity utilization by site. Plans link enrollment trends to facility actions including modernization, new construction, and adaptive reuse (Sections 1, 5, and Demographics).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational specifications are a core organizing principle, with detailed integration of district mission, SV Innovates initiative, and facilities planning. Facilities support diverse programs including TK, CTE, special education, collaborative learning, and technology-rich environments (Section 7a Educational Specifications).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Plans include data and analysis of outdoor spaces with strategies for shade structures, outdoor learning areas, and landscaping. However, districtwide greening and climate resilience framing are limited (Sections 5 and 7a Outdoor Learning Spaces).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate-related risks and includes some mitigation strategies such as shade structures and stormwater management. Climate readiness is a consideration but not a central theme with limited comprehensive risk assessment (Sections 5 and 7b Construction Standards).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes energy efficiency measures, HVAC upgrades, and references to Title 24 compliance. Energy resilience is mentioned with some backup power and solar strategies, but comprehensive districtwide energy resilience planning is not fully detailed (Sections 5 and 6 Financial Summary).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a detailed, comprehensive financial plan with itemized cost estimates, prioritization framework, and multiple funding sources including bonds, developer fees, and state programs. Includes escalation assumptions and contingency planning aligned with district priorities (Section 6 Financial Summary).
